// description: Minimal setup for running ImProcess as a stand-alone SNOUTY / OPM / MS-RESOLFT lightsheet processor. No hardware devices are declared - this setup is meant for opening existing HDF5/Zarr/TIFF acquisitions, running SNOUTY deskew or fast projection-preview reconstruction, calibrating/applying three-color strip alignment, and saving the result. To use, also set 'enabled' to ['improcess'] in modules.json.
